title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: The city’s impossible geography in one full sweep.
anchor: Christ early + Santa Teresa + Sugarloaf through golden hour.
morning: Early Corcovado / Christ by official transport before peak crowds.
Compact Santa Teresa / Selarón pass afterwards.
afternoon: Long carioca lunch, then 2-3 hours of beach/reset.
This is not dead time; it is part of Rio.
evening: Sugarloaf timed for late afternoon → sunset → city lights.
Casual dinner; no tasting menu tonight.
eat: Brazilian classics at lunch; boteco food at night.
logistics: Pre-book Christ and Sugarloaf timed entries.
Keep valuables minimal on mixed sightseeing/beach days.
places: Christ the Redeemer Rio de Janeiro

title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: Use the day lightly so Monday night can be the cultural anchor.
anchor: Pedra do Sal Monday roda de samba in Little Africa.
morning: Beach / slow breakfast. If flying conditions are excellent, hang-glide can move here as a weather flex.
afternoon: Guided Little Africa / Valongo context before the music, or move the history walk to Tuesday if the day is too full.
evening: Boteco bite, then Pedra do Sal Monday samba.
Go for music and atmosphere, not valuables.
eat: Cold chopp, bolinho, simple carioca food.
logistics: Rideshare to/from Little Africa at night.
Keep Tuesday as weather backup for hang-gliding.
watchOut: Phone and jewellery discreet at Pedra do Sal and in dense crowds.
places: Pedra do Sal Rio de Janeiro

title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: Today is for flying off a mountain and eating Rio at its highest level.
anchor: Tandem hang-glide/paraglide from Pedra Bonita + Lasai.
morning: Weather-dependent tandem flight from Pedra Bonita to São Conrado. Choose operator for safety, not price.
If weather cancels, move to Wed morning.
afternoon: Use any unfinished Little Africa or Santa Teresa context only if it stays relaxed.
evening: Dinner: Lasai if secured; Oteque / another genuinely Rio-forward alternative if not.
One excellent drink after, not forced clubbing.
logistics: The extra Rio nights are doing real work: weather can move the flight without breaking the trip.

title: Rio De Janeiro
intro: A final full Rio day ends inside a proper rivalry.
anchor: Botafogo vs Vasco at 20:30 - match night is the fixed anchor.
morning: Hang-glide backup if Tuesday weather failed. Otherwise beach, café, neighbourhood time.
afternoon: Long lunch, rest, sort official match tickets and transport.
No major sightseeing stack before a late football night.
evening: Go early to Estádio Nilton Santos area.
Botafogo vs Vasco da Gama at 20:30 - current fixture listing; official ticket release to monitor.
eat: Casual lunch and simple pre-match food.
logistics: Do not buy speculative inflated reseller tickets before official sale.
watchOut: Football crowds are intense. Minimal valuables, follow local match-day guidance.
places: Estádio Nilton Santos Rio de Janeiro

title: Rio → Iguaçu
intro: Leave Rio early enough to experience the falls, not merely arrive near them.
anchor: Brazilian falls circuit + Macuco Safari on the same day.
morning: GOL G31552 GIG→IGU currently scheduled 08:00→10:10 on Thu 8 Oct.
afternoon: Walk the Brazilian falls circuit for scale and panoramic views.
Macuco Safari into the spray - accept getting soaked.
evening: Do not commute across town for a “destination” dinner.
logistics: Waterproof pouch; quick-dry clothes; spare layer.
One night at the falls is enough because the routing now exits efficiently via CGH next morning.
watchOut: Macuco is not gentle sightseeing. Protect electronics and accept the drenching.

title: Iguaçu → Paraty
intro: Waterfall scale collapses into Atlantic rainforest and colonial streets by dusk.
anchor: Morning hop to Congonhas + private Costa Verde transfer + Paraty after day-trippers thin out.
morning: Azul AD6075 IGU→CGH currently 09:45→11:20 on Fri 9 Oct.
Skip Parque das Aves unless the flight changes later; protecting the transfer matters more.
afternoon: Private driver from CGH to Paraty (~4.5-5h depending traffic).
Arrive late afternoon; check in historic centre.
evening: Cachaça / caiçara dinner and slow walk on the cobbles after dark.
The town itself is the nightlife.
logistics: CGH is deliberately chosen over GRU for the road handoff.
Historic centre is pedestrian/cobbled; keep bags compact.
sleep: Paraty - Sandi / Pousada do Ouro / Pousada Literária.
decision: RECOMMENDED — Door-to-door; arrive by late afternoon

title: Paraty
intro: Boat into rainforest, climb above a fjord-like inlet, then jump into the water.
anchor: Saco do Mamanguá + Pico do Pão de Açúcar hike + swim.
morning: Early private/small boat to Saco do Mamanguá.
Start the steep climb while cooler.
afternoon: Summit view, descend, swim, quiet coves, caiçara lunch by the water.
evening: Return, shower, final Brazil dinner in the historic centre.
One good cachaça; tomorrow is the heavy logistics day.
logistics: Small/private boat, not a party schooner.
Good footwear; weather decides whether the hike is safe.
watchOut: Heavy rain/storms: switch to a lower-risk boat/cachaça/cultural day.
places: Pico do Pão de Açúcar Paraty Brazil
